title: Design: A/R Summary in dark theme looks as described
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows, as in the layout being checked.
  • Have a customer with a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a credit memo, so the page shows a long name and a credit memo row, which must not overlap or be cut off.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in dark theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab, also in dark theme, for comparison.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the title row and the filter row.
  2. Look at the chips in their resting state.
  3. Look at the customer names.
  4. Look at the "Total" column and the Totals row, and compare with Sales By Customer.
  5. Press Tab until a link has keyboard focus.
  6. Look across the whole page for any text that overlaps, is cut off, or is hard to read on the dark background.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title, info icon and ⋯ on one line, the filter row below, as in light theme.

Step 2:

  • "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" show in the resting (grey) style and are readable.

Step 3:

  • The native report link style, readable in dark theme.

Step 4:

  • "Total" pinned right and bold on the header, rows and Totals row.
  • The Totals row has the same native style as Sales By Customer's in dark theme.

Step 5:

  • The focused link is underlined.

Step 6:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or is hard to read.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S8-R4: “The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports.”
  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • S5-R15: “The Past due chip and its open menu are the same native checkbox dropdown as Customer and Location: label "Past due", an hourglass icon, an "Any" row, the native line "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow." while none is ticked, then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days", in that order; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the range when one is (for example "Past due: 91+ days"), and "Past due: N ranges" when N are. Ticking all four reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any, because Any also keeps invoices and bills that are not due yet. The ranges are the reports' own aging buckets: 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and more than 90 days past the due date on the as-of date.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 15): semi-bold, exactly as Work In Progress links look today; the design pictures will be corrected. This case follows the PRD (S7-R7, unchanged in version 9). The held design-version case D-80 (C715562) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Design note (DR-01): the design shows the Totals row sits on a light-grey band in some pictures (A/R Collection expanded, A/P Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices, A/R Detail I32) and on the page colour in others (Summaries, I28, the same A/R Detail screen in I30). Closed without a question: PRD S8-R4: "The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports." The cases compare with Sales By Customer's Totals row; the pictures are not the reference for this one attribute.

Design note (DR-04): the design shows the Customer menu with two ticked shows the ticked names as tags in the search box, a clear "×", and "2 selected" on the "All customers" row. Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R13 "Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter"; the PRD lists the menu's main rows, the design shows the native extras. The design case checks them.
